book.name: LUKE
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Luke wana Leleli

content: Yeisu Gamagalau ali Gewi Sebenti Tu I Patunal Hi Tagil
Toto o enaa, Babala gamagalau ali gewi sebenti tu (72) i hilel al ge eluwa eluwa i patunal hi houwa hi na panuwa ge awan gegewel bolo iya abwe ni nok elal.
He i baek elal i ba, “Eyowa i bwaya enona iyaka i matuwa, yaa totuwalali nige hi gegewi. He nuku awanun Babala toneyowa elana totuwalali ni patunal nihi na wana eyowaa ge enona nihi pahi.
Nuku nok. Ya papatunamiu i ola sipi hi nana ewalili sosokal gamwaliyaa.
Bahi wami mani abana, o ebo ami kaliko ana nabwa, o ebo aemiu aana nuku nonoahe. Bahi nuku nonotaltalmilil ge alomiyau gamagalau nuku liliwaliwan.
Sauga ebo nuku ha limi etega elana, houwan nuku baek elal nuku ba, ‘Minamina waiwaisana Yehoba ni pewa limi ya ana heniheni eliyamiu.’
Ebo minamina waiwaisana ana gamagalau hi miminaa o, wami ba mulolu minamina waiwaisana kaiwena ni mihot. Ebo nigeya, komiu ya te minamina waiwaisana nuku pwawa, yaa heliya nigeya.
Nuku minaa limi o elana, inoke aanan ge wewel toto hi pewa nuku imwimwa ge nuku anana, kaiwena totuwalali molana ni gan. Bahi nuku gagalanawanawa limi ge limi ona elal.
Ebo nuku ulutuk panuwa etega ge gamagalau o nihi yaliyaya kaiwemiu, aanan toto hi lovivina-an kaiwemiu nuku an ya.
Panuwa o wali tokasiyebwa nuku pwamolol ge gamagalau wali wasa nuku pek nuku ba, ‘Yehoba wana abalogugui iyaka i nokelakelaubwa eliyamiu.’
Ebo nuku ulutuk panuwa etega elana ge gamagalau o nige nihi yayaliyaya kaiwemiu, nuku nok nuku na wali kamwasaa ge nuku ba,
‘Wami panuwa papakovana toto aema i papakove ha hapul yoho eliyamiu ge nuku atena abwe ami lahi nuku pwawa. Yaa nuku atena bubun te Yehoba wana abalogugui ana sauga iyaka i kelaubwa.’
Na baewa eliyamiu, lan o elana Sodoma ali lahi ni pulowan, yaa panuwa o ali lahi nasi ni pulowan hot.

Eeu! Kolasin geb, bwaliga nuku nak! Eeu! Betesaida geb, bwaliga nuku nak! Binimala ginol yawiyawi toto ya ginola eliyamiu na ginola Taya ge Saidoni elal, he beyaunana kaliko toto bwasumu pupunona elana hi ginoliya nihi galoi nihi misiyowa papakova gamwanaa, inoke nihi pamasalil te iyaka wali gegi ana en hi pek.
Yatala ana lan elana, Taya ge Saidoni ali lahi ni pulowan, yaa komiu ami lahi nasi ni pulowan hot.
Ga i ola komiu Kapeniyama! Age nuwamiu alamiu nuku teli heyan natiya? Yaa nasi nihi alipalomiu nuku lau Gehena.”
Yaka Yeisu i baek wana tohago elal i ba, “Henala ebo wami baaba ni hago, he nau no baaba i hago. Henala ebo ni towaagimiu, he i towaagau, ge henala i towaagau, he toto i patunau te i towani.”
Gamagalau Sebenti Tu Hi Sikal Yeisu elana
Gamagalau ali toto sebenti tu (72) hi sikal ginebi wali yaliyaya ge hi ba, “Babala, bwagana yayaluwa bibikel, sauga alam elana ha baek elal, he wama baaba hi hago.”
Analiya i lahe i ba, “Ya gagayawa ge Seitani ya kite wana gasisi i so, i soguem labulabumwa i ola pinamal.
Wami gasisi ya pewa inoke mwata ge vagiyei nuku pulilolowagil ge ami topihigelgel Seitani wana gasisi nuku pakokove; nige bugul etega ni aapanakimiu.
Yaa bahi tage yayaluwa bibikel wami baaba hi hago ge kaiwena nuwamiu ni waisi. He nuwamiu ni waisi kaiwena alamiu Yehoba iyaka i leli lowan wana bukiya labulabumwa.”

Sauga o elana Yayaluwa Bwabwalena eliyana Yeisu yaliyaya i kalaopopwi ge i ba, “Nam, labulabum ge panayawi ali Babala, ya tobalagiwa kaiwena wam abalogugui ana aatena u sume tosiba ge toatena elal ge iyaka u pamasal bolo hi ola wawayau elal. Ibwe Nam, kaiwena wam nuwatu i ola.
“Aatena gegewena Nam iyaka i pem ge na pamasal gamagalau elal. Nige etega i aatenau, iyai te Nam, ge nige etega Nam i aatena, iyai te nau Natuna ge bolo na hilel Nam na pamasal elal.”
Yeisu i tagena pil matana i nok wana tohago elal ge heliya ya i baek elal i ba, “Gamagalau bolo hauna komiu ku kite heliya hi kite, he heliya hi waisi.

Na baewa eliyamiu, palopitau ge kin houhouwel hi gewi nuwaliya hot hauna komiu ku kite heliya nihi kite, yaa nige hi kikite, ge nuwaliya hot hauna komiu ku hago ya panpankiti-an heliya nihi hago, yaa nige hi hahago.”
Gagama Sameliya Yudiya Gamagalina I Labe Liwanina
Sauga etega elana Logugui ana toatena etega i lut ge Yeisu i labose i neli i ba, “Topankite, hauna na ginol ge yawal mihomihotina na pwawa?”
Anana Yeisu i lahe i ba, “Buki Bwabwalena ana baaba ga i ba ola? Ana sapu ga u ahe ola?”

Yaka tau i ba, “‘Yehoba wam Yabowaine nu nunuwana-an ginebi ge atem bwalibwaligena, yawalim bwalibwaligena, wam gasisi bwalibwaligena ge wam nuwatu bwalibwaligena,’ ge ‘Alom nu nunuwana-an ni ola totom u nunuwana-agiwa.’”
Yeisu i baek elana i ba, “He u lahe bubun to. Nu ginol ola inoke yawal mihomihotina nu ahe.”
Yaa Logugui ana toatena nuwana totona ni teli heyan te iya tosapu, inoke i nel Yeisu elana i ba, “He henala alou ge na nunuwana-an?”

Wana nel Yeisu i lahe i ba, “Tau etegana i noem Yelusalema i nana i lalau panuwa Yeliko kaiwena. He tokaoma hi bunsumiya kamwasaa, inoke wana bugubugul gegewena hi kaome ge hi nibinibihan kelaubwa ni aliga, yaka abwe hi eguluwan.
He sauga o elana topowon etega i nawaa kamwasa maisena o elana. Sauga tau o i kite i kenukenu, inoke i nogegel i noek kamwasa labena etega.
I ola al tapwalolo ana totuwalali etega un Libai gamagalina, i pulivin labi o elana ge tau o i kite, inoke i nogegel i noek kamwasa labena etega.
Yaa Sameliya gamagalina etega i heya wana donki pwatanaa ge i nawanawa i na i vin labi toto tau i kenukenuwa, i kite inoke atena i lomwanan.

Yaka i nok i na gegelinaa, olibe enonona alona ge oine i ahe ana bon i sawaliya ge i os. Inoke i kalivai heyan i teliya donki toto iya i heya pwatanaa ge hi na hi tagil panuwaa, yaka abwe i pwatanik limi bwabwali etega elana ge i matahikan.
Lan i gan al, inoke silba eluwa i pek tonlimi elana ge i baek elana i ba, ‘Tau ya nu matahikan, inoke sauga ebo na sikalim, hauna toto al u payaomal iya kaiwena, abwe na pwamola pasikal eliyam.’”
Inoke Yeisu i nel Logugui ana toatena elana i ba, “He ga u nuwatu ola? Gamagalau ali toto eton gamwaliyaa, henala tau toto tokaoma hi nibinibihan alona, ge i nunuwana-an?”
Yaka tau nel i lahe i ba, “Toto i atilomwan-an ge i labe.” Inoke Yeisu i baek elana i ba, “He nu nok nu na nu ginol ni ola al to.”
Yeisu I Na Mata ge Talina Meli wali Limiya
Yeisu alonau ge wana tohago hi nawanawa hi na hi vin awan etega elana. Yova etega iyoho to, alana Mata, iya Yeisu i pwamwa tukan wana limiya.
He Mata talina i gan alana Meli, iya i na i misiyowa Yeisu aena gegelinaa ge wana liwaliwan i lalaegan.

Yaa Mata i nuwanuwatu nabi aanan ana lovivina ge tuwalali enuna al kaiweliya. Inoke i na Yeisu elana ge i ba, “Babala, tab u nuwanuwatu te taliu i eguluwagau maiseu ya te tuwalali gegewena ya awaawaginol e? U baek elana ni nem ge ni labeyau.”
Babala Mata anana i lahe i ba, “Mata, Mata, owa u nuwanuwatu nabi bugul hi gewi kaiweliya,
yaa bugul maisena ya te ana nuwatu i bwata. Toto Meli i hile, he i waisi hot, inoke bahi gamagal etega ni lolopwali.”
